hypothesis: Automatically extracted and validation-gated procedural skills improve held-out analysis quality over the same PI agent without skills.

source-train.purpose: Create trajectories for automatic extraction; may update candidate skills.

source-valid.purpose: Accept or reject one candidate at a time; may freeze the final package.

source-test.purpose: Primary held-out source-domain result; no protocol, prompt, budget, or skill changes afterward.

target-test.purpose: Cross-benchmark transfer result; run only after source-test and never tune from it.

reporting.aggregation: report per-system mean, standard deviation, paired case deltas, bootstrap confidence intervals, and cost-normalized quality
reporting.claim_boundary: Published baselines are contextual, not matched-model causal comparisons. The causal comparison is pi-core versus pi-auto-skills.
